Amy L.: Wrapping up the reliability Q&A  dropping this live thread to capture owners and timelines from the session. RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/INC-3841

Ravi S.: Thanks Amy. Quick ask from product: we promised a clear date for the fallback routing canary. Can we lock that today?

Maya K.: +1 from support. Also need the exact rollback signals so docs match the runbook.

Ben H.: Proposing canary start 2026-04-09 in prod-canary, 48h monitoring window. Initial traffic ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 15% over 24h if green.

Ravi S.: Works for product. Please include a calendar invite.

Maya K.: Rollback signals suggestion: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency +25% vs baseline for 10m. Also pause if >=2 P1 customer reports in the window.

Ben H.: Adding implementer note:
```
kubectl apply -f ops/fallback-2026-04-09.yaml --context=prod-canary
```
Pause windows: 10m between ramps. Keep burst window at 30s.

DevOps-bot: Canary rollout queued: fallback-2026-04-09 in prod-canary at 2026-03-27T09:00:00Z (build 1242).

Amy L.: Who's the single owner for RCA action tracking/weekly updates? We need one contact for exec updates.

Ravi S.: I will own the action register and publish a Friday snapshot. Assignments so far: fallback canary -> @Ben H., tracing retention bump -> @Maya K., partner follow-ups -> @Amy L.

Maya K.: Tracing cost estimate is ~4k/mo. Amy, can you confirm finance okays if under 5k?

Amy L.: Yes I can approve sub-5k. I'll loop in finance and note approval on the register.

Ben H.: I'll open the canary PR and tag product/support. Expect PR within 3 hours.

Amy L.: Thanks all. I'll consolidate and post the master action register here. Ping me directly if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
